candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

review_output.decision_rationale: Stage 2 canonical criteria IC.1-IC.4 and EC.1-EC.4 are satisfied by Lopez et al. 2019: it is an English-language primary research article describing an NLP-enabled method to extract process components from natural-language text (Process Highlighter with NLP). The paper provides a concrete method (NLP-assisted marking of roles/activities/constraints) and references empirical evaluations of the tool, with statements about positive evaluations and exploratory results. The full text is available and the work demonstrates method description and empirical validation signals.
